scope: Per-channel encoders, writer/map transfer, player/camera state, telestrator operations, timing, queues, and generic boundaries

applied.name: ReplayRecording_HasEligibleHumanPlayer
applied.evidence: Scans eight slots and recognizes an active eligible human player.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceQueue_Reset
applied.evidence: Destroys queued voice nodes and resets the queue cursor and counters.

applied.name: ReplayCameraController_Reset
applied.evidence: Clears the active flag and resets all eight per-player camera slots.

applied.name: ReplayFrameSchedule_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the shared list sentinel and initializes its cached iterator.

applied.name: PlayerList_SetLocalPlayerIndex
applied.evidence: Stores the signed local-player slot byte at PlayerList offset 0xFC.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeMetadataChannel
applied.evidence: Selects due metadata/control records, serializes them, and advances the per-channel queue and last-frame state.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeVoiceChannel
applied.evidence: Selects due VoiceStreamData records, serializes them, and advances the voice queue and schedule state.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeTelestratorChannel
applied.evidence: Selects due TelestratorStreamData records and emits channel-4 data.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeGameCommandChannel
applied.evidence: Selects due GameCommandStreamData records and emits channel-1 data.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_EncodeCameraChannel
applied.evidence: Selects due CameraStreamData records and emits channel-2 data.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_ReceiveMapAsset
applied.evidence: Runs the map-transfer state machine for one embedded replay map asset.

applied.name: ReplayChannelSchedule_FindOrInsertFrame
applied.evidence: Finds the schedule record for a frame or inserts a zeroed 0x38-byte one in frame order.

applied.name: ReplayWriter_Start
applied.evidence: Copies header/output state, creates the writer job, and optionally pumps it synchronously until the startup phase completes.

applied.name: ReplayTelestrator_DecodeOperation0
applied.evidence: Decodes operation type 0 as two 32-bit identifiers plus one encoded point and invokes callback slot 0.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_SetFrameOrResetTiming
applied.evidence: Stores the playback frame; sentinel frame values reset performance timing and release the retained voice packet.

applied.name: ReplayPlayerSlots_CopyFrom
applied.evidence: Copies the match-level player state and all eight 92-byte player slots.

applied.name: ReplayCameraQueue_PopAndCloneFront
applied.evidence: Clones the front camera payload, removes its queue node, and returns the new 20-byte CameraStreamData object.

applied.name: SpectatorCameraController_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the identified SpectatorCameraController and its 1064-byte owned camera implementation.

applied.name: ReplayQueues_AppendFilteredCameraStream
applied.evidence: Builds and appends the camera stream accepted by playback's local-player filter path, then releases temporaries.

applied.name: ReplayTelestrator_DecodeOperation1
applied.evidence: Decodes operation type 1 point data and invokes callback slot 1.

applied.name: ReplayTelestrator_DecodeOperation2
applied.evidence: Decodes operation type 2 point data and invokes callback slot 2.

applied.name: ReplayEncoderPair_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs two 2852-byte encoder contexts and initializes their shared state and readiness fields.

applied.name: ReplayEncoder_PumpWriterJob
applied.evidence: Finalizes ready encoder output when appropriate and pumps its writer job.

applied.name: ReplayHeader_EncodePlayerType
applied.evidence: Maps engine slot states 3 through 7 to replay header codes 1 through 5.

applied.name: ReplayChannelScheduleEntry_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the scheduled-channel entry and initializes its frame and iterator fields.

applied.name: ReplayHeader_SetMetadataBlob
applied.evidence: Replaces the owned replay-header metadata blob with an exact-size copy.

applied.name: GameMessageVector_ResizeForLoad
applied.evidence: Allocates storage for a loaded GameMessage vector, destroys old storage, and installs the new base pointer.

applied.name: ReplayEncoderJob_Reset
applied.evidence: Cancels the active encoder job handle and restores encoder state 1.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_FailMatchInitialization
applied.evidence: Sets the playback failure state, resets match setup, shuts down the match object, and clears the associated string.

applied.name: UnicodeString_ConcatInto
applied.evidence: Finalizes a two-input UnicodeString concatenation expression into the destination; it is a generic string boundary used by replay file copy.

applied.name: ReplayMatchSetup_SetTimestampNow
applied.evidence: Stores the current 64-bit time in the match setup and releases the temporary string argument.

applied.name: VoiceStreamQueueNode_Allocate
applied.evidence: Allocates and copy-constructs one 28-byte VoiceStreamData list node.

applied.name: TelestratorStreamQueueNode_Allocate
applied.evidence: Allocates and copy-constructs one 28-byte TelestratorStreamData node.

applied.name: MetadataStreamQueueNode_Allocate
applied.evidence: Allocates and copy-constructs one 28-byte MetaStreamData list node.

applied.name: CameraStreamQueueNode_Allocate
applied.evidence: Allocates and copy-constructs one 28-byte CameraStreamData list node.

applied.name: GameCommandQueueNode_Allocate
applied.evidence: Allocates and copy-constructs one 28-byte GameCommandStreamData node.

applied.name: ObjectReferenceVector_AllocateStorage
applied.evidence: Thin allocation boundary used when growing replay object references.

applied.name: CameraStateVector_Insert
applied.evidence: Inserts the supplied recovered camera state into the owned vector.

applied.name: KWReplayOwnedSource_Destroy
applied.evidence: Runs both identified owned-source subobject destructors and frees the reader's auxiliary source object.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_AdvanceTimingAccumulator
applied.evidence: Converts the accumulated performance-counter interval by logic FPS and subtracts the dispatched amount.

applied.name: ReplayCameraEncoder_HasEmptyQueue
applied.evidence: Tests the two camera encoder side queues and reports whether either is empty, as required by final drain readiness.

applied.name: ReplayPlayback_CancelActiveJob
applied.evidence: Moves playback to state 5 and cancels its active job handle.

applied.name: ReplayVoicePacketRef_Ctor
applied.evidence: Initializes the retained voice-packet reference and increments its shared reference count.

applied.name: ReplayTelestrator_DecodeOperation3
applied.evidence: Decodes operation type 3 and invokes callback slot 3.

applied.name: ReplayBufferingControl_SetFrameLimit
applied.evidence: Stores a frame limit capped at thirty seconds of the current logic FPS.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkRecordDecoder_ClearCounters
applied.evidence: Clears the decoder's buffered, staged, and consumed counters.

applied.name: ReplayDirectory_GetInitializedRoot
applied.evidence: Ensures the replay directory root singleton is initialized and returns it.
